title.narrative: Supporting Yemeni children’s access to quality education opportunities

description.narrative: - Supporting national exams for grades (9-12). - Training and building the capabilities of teachers and improving the quality of education. - Providing school supplies to support students’ continuation of education -Enhancing awareness of the importance of education and returning to school - Providing girls with hygiene materials and hygiene materials in schools
Ensuring girls and boys' continued access to quality education by equipping schools, providing educational supplies to students, and building the capabilities of educational staff.
Reaching 639,000 beneficiaries in 22 Yemeni governorates and ensuring the continuation of the educational process there
